description: This loop walk follows the Sruffaunboy Nature Trail in the Connemara National Park. The walk starts from the visitor centre car park in the village of Letterfrack. You'll then follow a 1.7km circular trail past peaceful woodland with some fine views of Barnaderg Bay and Diamond Hill. You can extend the route by climbing to Diamond Hill for more amazing views.
